clips.title: The story
paras: At the Dead Fields, Nightlash's defeat leaves a trace the Forsaken can carry away. High Executor Hadrec needs it as proof that the Scourge force behind the rot hide gnolls has been broken.

At the abandoned farmstead called the Dead Fields in northern Silverpine, packs of undead rot hide gnolls have dug in under Scourge command. Forsaken assaults have failed again and again, not because of the feral gnolls, but because their spectral commander, Nightlash, turns them back. Her wailing magic strengthens the gnoll lines and routs forces sent from the Sepulcher. When Nightlash is slain, her incorporeal form dissolves into dust, leaving a crystalline magical essence behind.

Banshees leave no bodily corpse, so Nightlash's essence is the only physical proof that the spirit has been destroyed. High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher needs it to confirm that the Scourge foothold has fallen. With that proof, the Forsaken can secure their northern perimeter and suppress the rot hide threat.
